15–30 min (plus the time to hunt the Bast Skirts)

The cyclops smith {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops}, in Ab'Dendriel, will only work for you after you do him a favour: three {item:Bast Skirt|Bast Skirts} for his 'girlfriend'. From then on he turns armours, shields, helmets and weapons into rare metals for addons and quests, and {item:Soul Orb|Soul Orbs} into {item:Infernal Bolt|Infernal Bolts}.
No minimum level (20+ recommended to hunt the Bast Skirts).
Being able to swap items with {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} (see the table in section 2)
Trades with A Sweaty Cyclops (rare metals and Infernal Bolts)
When you hand the 3 {item:Bast Skirt|Bast Skirts} to {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} ({key:bast skirt}, {key:yes}).
The quest appears in the Quest Log under **Friends and Traders**.
The swaps are widely used in other quests and addons: keep this NPC in mind.

Hunt {creature:Dworc Venomsniper|Dworc Venomsnipers} until you have 3 {item:Bast Skirt|Bast Skirts}. You find the Venomsnipers in the {wiki:Tiquanda/Trapwood|Trapwood}, **south of Port Hope** ({coord:32688,32911,7}), on the surface and in the Dworc caves, and also in the Foreigner Quarter of {wiki:Yalahar}. To get to the Trapwood, take the boat to **Port Hope** (say {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to the captain in your city) and walk **south**.
Map of the Trapwood, south of Port Hope

The entrances to the Dworc caves are on the south coast of the Trapwood: several hidden pitfalls and a staircase. Most pitfalls lead to 'traps' closed off by wooden fences that you have to break with a weapon. To leave, go back to the stairs (or use the {item:Rope} on a rope spot), walk **north** to Port Hope and take the boat there to Thais, Venore or Edron, which have a boat to Ab'Dendriel.

Go to **Ab'Dendriel** (by boat, say {key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes} to the captain in Thais, Carlin, Venore or Edron; you arrive at {npc:Captain Seagull}'s boat). {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} lives on the **4th floor of a tower** to the **northeast** of the depot: enter the small {creature:Rotworm|Rotworm} cave beneath the **wheat field east of the depot**, cross it to the tower and climb to the top floor.
A Sweaty Cyclops (4th floor of the tower)
Asking the cyclops for the favour
Talk to {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops}. Say {key:hi}, {key:uth'lokr}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. He says he will only work after you do him a favour: three Bast Skirts for the woman he dances with.
With the 3 Bast Skirts in your inventory, say {key:bast skirt} and {key:yes}. From now on the cyclops forges metals and items for you.
Access to A Sweaty Cyclops' swaps
To go back to Ab'Dendriel, take the same route in reverse: go down the tower floors, cross the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworm} cave and climb out to the wheat field east of the depot.
Bring the source item, say {key:hi}, the keyword from the table and {key:yes}. He replies *"Cling clang!"* and hands you the result.
Use these keywords for each swap.
3 {item:Infernal Bolt|Infernal Bolts} for each Soul Orb

With {key:soul orb} he swaps **all** your Soul Orbs at once. If you do not have enough capacity, reply *"No can do. Make some room in your inventory first."*. He does not subtract the weight of the Soul Orbs: for 1000 Soul Orbs you need to start with **2900 oz** free (not 2700). To keep it simple, count 1 oz for each bolt.
